question: Compare Tanishq's and Titan Company's store-count growth over the last two years -- which grew faster, and does Titan's overall retail footprint include brands beyond Tanishq?
answer: Using Titan’s official, recent disclosures, Tanishq’s network grew from 479 stores in FY2023-24 to 557 in FY2025-26, an increase of 78 stores or about 16.3%. Titan’s overall network rose from 3,035 to 3,603 outlets over the same period, an increase of 568 or about 18.7%, so Titan grew faster in both absolute and percentage terms. Titan’s footprint extends beyond Tanishq and includes brands such as Mia, Zoya, CaratLane, Titan World, Helios and Titan Eye+; the FY2025-26 total also includes Damas.

claims.text: Tanishq added 78 stores, representing growth of about 16.3%, from FY2023-24 to FY2025-26.
Titan’s overall retail network had 3,035 outlets in FY2023-24.
Titan’s overall retail network had 3,603 outlets in FY2025-26.
Titan’s overall network added 568 outlets, representing growth of about 18.7%, from FY2023-24 to FY2025-26.
Titan’s overall store count grew faster than Tanishq’s in both absolute and percentage terms over the period.
Titan’s retail footprint includes Mia, Zoya, CaratLane, Titan World, Helios and Titan Eye+ in addition to Tanishq.
Titan’s FY2025-26 overall network total includes Damas.

Verify which other brands contribute to Titan’s total footprint; skip Tanishq’s founding-date discrepancies and unrelated Titan Capital funding because they do not affect this comparison.

retrieval.text:
**Latest FY2025–26 investor presentation:** Titan’s **Q4 / FY26 Earnings Presentation**, released **May 8, 2026**. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/investors/corporate-announcements))

**Store network as of March 31, 2026:**

| Metric | Store count |
|---|---:|
| **Tanishq — domestic** | **528** |
| **Tanishq — international** | **29** |
| **Tanishq — total** | **557** |
| **Titan consumer-business retail network — domestic** | **3,441** |
| **Titan consumer-business retail network — international** | **162** |
| **Titan consumer-business retail network — total** | **3,603** |

The presentation also reports Tanishq’s presence across **311 towns**, with domestic stores rising by 8 and international stores by 4 during Q4 FY26. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2026-05/Q4FY26%20Earnings%20Presentation%20-%20Uploaded.pdf?utm_source=openai))

Note: Titan’s **3,603** figure is the combined consumer-business network and includes the Damas acquisition; **127 Damas stores** were added in Q4 FY26. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2026-04/Titan%20-%20Q4FY26-%20Quarterly%20Update.pdf?utm_source=openai))

retrieval.query: site:titancompany.in investor presentation FY2023-24 FY2024-25 Tanishq stores total retail outlets
retrieval.text:
### Titan retail footprint — FY2023-24 vs. FY2024-25  
*Year-end figures as of March 31.*

| Metric | FY2023-24 | FY2024-25 | Change |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| **Tanishq stores — domestic** | 464 | 501 | +37 |
| **Tanishq stores — international** | 15 | 21 | +6 |
| **Tanishq stores — total** | **479** | **522** | **+43** |
| **Titan consolidated retail outlets** | **3,035** | **3,312** | **+277** |

FY24’s Tanishq total comprised **464 domestic and 15 international** stores; the FY24 investor deck’s aggregate count is 479. ([scribd.com](https://www.scribd.com/document/808152910/1PPT-titan?utm_source=openai))  

For FY25, Titan’s Q4 investor presentation reports **501 domestic Tanishq stores plus 21 international**, or **522 total**. Its consolidated company retail network was **3,312 stores**, versus **3,035 at March 2024**. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2025-05/Q4FY25%20-%20Earnings%20presentation%20Uploaded_0.pdf))  

**Note:** Titan’s jewellery-segment store total is not the same as its overall retail-outlet figure. The overall **3,035 / 3,312** totals cover Titan’s consolidated businesses—jewellery, watches, eyewear, emerging businesses, etc.

### Retail-network snapshot

| Business | Brand | Store network / disclosure |
|---|---|---:|
| Jewellery | **Tanishq** | **528 domestic** + **29 international** stores as of March 31, 2026 |
| Jewellery | **Mia by Tanishq** | **282 domestic** + **1 international** store |
| Jewellery | **Zoya** | **13** stores |
| Jewellery | **CaratLane** | **370 domestic** + **2 international** stores |
| Watches | **Titan World** | **729** stores* |
| Watches | **Helios** | **283** stores* |
| Eyecare | **Titan Eye+** | Titan’s current brand page says **950+ stores nationwide** |

\*Titan World and Helios counts are from Titan’s official franchise page; its figures appear to reflect a reporting point different from the March 2026 jewellery disclosure. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2026-05/Q4FY26%20Earnings%20Presentation%20-%20Uploaded.pdf?utm_source=openai))

For comparison, the prior **FY 2024–25 annual report** showed: **Tanishq 522, CaratLane 323, Mia 234, and Zoya 12** stores. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2025-06/Titan%20AR%202024-25%20AR.pdf?utm_source=openai))

Titan identifies **Tanishq, Zoya, Mia, and CaratLane** as jewellery brands; **Titan World** and **Helios** operate in watches retail, while **Titan Eye+** is its eyecare retail brand. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/our-brands?utm_source=openai))
